observations: Two white plastic tanks inside galvanized steel cages stacked on wooden pallets.
Top tank has a spigot with a blue handle and white cap.
Labels are affixed to the cages but the text is not legible in the photos.
Plastic tanks show staining and discoloration; pallets and cage bases show rust.
A black cloth covers the top of the upper tank in photo 2.

risks.proof: video of tank being filled and held, or close-up of seams and valve area

Video of filling and draining to check for leaks and valve operation

response.reason: The item is identifiable as a used caged plastic tank (IBC tote) from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (unknown history, possible leaks) while proof is requested to raise value.
